scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Did you know Harbor Trading turns twenty this month?
scene.zh: 你知道 Harbor Trading 這個月就滿二十年了嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: I'd like you to organize our anniversary celebration.
scene.zh: 我想請你來籌辦我們的週年慶祝會。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Do you have a date in mind for the party?
scene.zh: 派對的日期您有想法了嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: A Saturday evening, near the end of the month.
scene.zh: 月底附近的某個星期六晚上。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: How many people do you expect to attend?
scene.zh: 您估計會有多少人參加？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: About eighty, counting guests. It's more of a social occasion.
scene.zh: 八十人左右，包含大家帶來的來賓。算是比較聯誼性質的場合。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: You're the leader on this one. Ask Dan for help.
scene.zh: 這次由你負責，Dan 可以幫你。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: We don't need a theme. Just make it a night to remember.
scene.zh: 不用特別定主題，讓大家有個難忘的夜晚就好。

fills.en: We need a ___ that holds about eighty people.
fills.zh: 我們要找一個能容納八十人左右的場地。
fills.note: 能容納八十人的是場地：venue。

fills.en: We want a venue ___ has round tables.
fills.zh: 我們想找一個有圓桌的場地。
fills.note: 說明「物」用 that；who 只用在人。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: So, where are we having this party? Any ideas?
scene.zh: 所以，這個派對要在哪裡辦？你有想法嗎？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: We need a venue that holds about eighty people.
scene.zh: 我們要找一個能容納八十人左右的場地。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: An outdoor party could be fun. But it's November.
scene.zh: 辦戶外派對應該很好玩，可是現在是十一月耶。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: What about Lakeside Hall? The location is perfect, close to the office.
scene.zh: Lakeside Hall 怎麼樣？地點很理想，離公司很近。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Does the hall have a stage for the speeches?
scene.zh: 那個宴會廳有可以致詞的舞台嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Yes, a small one. And they have ten round tables.
scene.zh: 有，一個小舞台。而且他們有十張圓桌。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: It's not too fancy, but they do banquets there all the time.
scene.zh: 不會太高級，不過他們常常辦宴會。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Did you hear back from the caterer?
scene.zh: 外燴那邊回你了嗎？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: The food is delivered at five and served at six thirty.
scene.zh: 餐點五點送到，六點半開始供應。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Great. Here's the menu. Their chef only uses fresh ingredients.
scene.zh: 很好。菜單在這裡。他們的主廚只用新鮮的食材。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Are there any dishes for guests who don't eat meat?
scene.zh: 有沒有不吃肉的來賓也能吃的菜？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Yes, the vegetarian dishes are marked in green.
scene.zh: 有，素食的菜都用綠色標出來了。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Beverages are on the back: coffee, tea and juice.
scene.zh: 飲料在背面：咖啡、茶和果汁。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: They make a traditional cake, too. We should go taste it!
scene.zh: 他們還有做傳統蛋糕。我們應該去試吃看看！

passages.title: You're Invited to Our Anniversary Celebration!
lines: Harbor Trading is twenty years old this month, and you are invited to our anniversary celebration!
6:00 Doors open, and beverages are served.
8:00 Award ceremony, hosted by Ms. Carter. Mr. Ellis will recognize the people who made this a great year.
8:30 Entertainment: a live band and a prize drawing. If you are lucky, you could win a new laptop!
Each employee may bring one guest. Please reply to this invitation by Friday, November 14, so we can give the caterer the final number.
We hope to see you there!

questions.en: How many guests can each employee bring?
questions.zh: 每位員工可以帶幾個人？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: I finished the party invitation. Could you check it for me?
scene.zh: 派對的邀請函我寫好了。可以幫我看一下嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: At the award ceremony, Mr. Ellis will recognize a few people.
scene.zh: 頒獎典禮上，Ellis 先生會表揚幾個人。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: After that, there's a band and a prize drawing.
scene.zh: 之後有樂團表演和抽獎。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Does everything look okay? Then it's ready to go.
scene.zh: 都沒問題嗎？那就可以寄了。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I'll send out the invitations before I leave today.
scene.zh: 我今天下班前會把邀請函寄出去。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Thanks. People need to reply by Friday, so the caterer knows the number.
scene.zh: 謝謝。大家要在星期五前回覆，外燴那邊才知道人數。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: And who knows? Maybe you'll be the lucky one who wins the laptop!
scene.zh: 而且誰知道呢？說不定你就是抽中筆電的那個幸運兒！

lines.en: The photographer just called. He'll be half an hour late.
lines.zh: 攝影師剛剛打來，他會晚半小時。

lines.en: So he gets here at five thirty? That's okay.
lines.zh: 所以他五點半到？那還好。

lines.en: By the door, I put up old pictures from the last twenty years.
lines.zh: 我在門口貼了公司這二十年來的老照片。

lines.en: Twenty years of memories! Every picture tells a story.
lines.zh: 二十年的回憶！每張照片都有一個故事。

lines.en: Right. And each round table needs a bowl of fruit.
lines.zh: 對啊。還有，每張圓桌都要放一碗水果。

lines.en: I'll do that. How are the speakers?
I fixed the left one. The sound is excellent now.
lines.zh: 左邊那個我修好了，現在聲音很棒。

lines.en: Guests arrive at six tonight. Let's hope there's no big crowd at the door.
lines.zh: 來賓今晚六點到。希望門口不要擠一大堆人。

questions.en: What time will the photographer arrive?
What did Dan put up by the door?

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Could you help me decorate the stage this afternoon?
scene.zh: 今天下午可以幫我佈置一下舞台嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Sure. Let's start with the lights over the stage.
scene.zh: 好啊。先從舞台上面的燈開始吧。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Mr. Ellis gives his speech up there tonight, right?
scene.zh: Ellis 先生今晚要在上面致詞，對吧？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Let me make sure the microphone is working.
scene.zh: 我確認一下麥克風有沒有聲音。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Good idea. I'll turn on the speakers.
scene.zh: 好主意。我來把喇叭打開。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: That's loud! The whole crowd will hear you.
scene.zh: 好大聲！全場的人都聽得到。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Okay, the stage is done. Let's do the round tables next.
scene.zh: 好，舞台弄好了。接下來弄圓桌吧。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: The photographer gets here at five thirty, so we have time.
scene.zh: 攝影師五點半才到，所以我們還有時間。

textFills.title: Tonight's party
lines: The party starts at six tonight. If you ___ early, please help Dan with the tables.
Our band has two musicians, and one of them tells really ___ jokes. Get ready to laugh!
Please stay ___ the photographer takes a group photo at nine thirty.
zh: 派對今晚六點開始。如果你早到，請幫 Dan 擺桌子。
我們的樂團有兩位樂手，其中一位很會講好笑的笑話。準備好大笑吧！
請留到九點半攝影師拍大合照之後再走。

blanks.note: If 後面用現在式講未來，不加 will。
後面說準備好大笑，所以笑話是 funny（好笑的）。
留到某件事發生為止用 until。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Look at everyone laughing. What a wonderful night!
scene.zh: 你看大家笑得多開心。今晚真是太棒了！

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: That musician on the guitar is great, too.
scene.zh: 那個彈吉他的樂手也很厲害。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: But the buffet is almost empty already.
scene.zh: 可是自助餐檯已經快空了。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: If we run out of food, I'll let the caterer know.
scene.zh: 如果菜不夠了，我會跟外燴業者說。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Thanks. Here, let me pour you some juice.
scene.zh: 謝啦。來，我幫你倒點果汁。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Mr. Ellis is so generous. The cake is his treat!
scene.zh: Ellis 先生真大方，蛋糕是他請客的！

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Let's take a group photo before everyone goes home.
scene.zh: 趁大家還沒回家，我們來拍張大合照吧。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Good idea! I'll go find the photographer.
scene.zh: 好主意！我去找攝影師。

lines.en: Thank you all for coming tonight.
Twenty years ago, Harbor Trading was two people in one small room.
lines.zh: 二十年前，Harbor Trading 只是一個小房間裡的兩個人。

lines.en: I had a dream, but I couldn't imagine a night like this.
lines.zh: 我有一個夢想，但從沒想像過會有今晚這樣的場面。

lines.en: We succeeded because of the strong relationships we built with our clients.
lines.zh: 我們能成功，是因為和客戶建立了很好的關係。

lines.en: And because everyone in this room made a contribution.
lines.zh: 也因為在座的每一位都有貢獻。

lines.en: Tonight, I also have a surprise for one person in this room.
lines.zh: 今晚我還要給在座的一位同事一個驚喜。

lines.en: This person joined us only a year ago and had an outstanding first year.
lines.zh: 這位同事一年前才加入，第一年就表現得非常傑出。

lines.en: Truly impressive work, and always so dedicated.
lines.zh: 工作表現真的很出色，而且一直都很投入。

lines.en: It is my honor to give the Employee of the Year award to the person who organized this party!
lines.zh: 我很榮幸把年度最佳員工獎，頒給籌辦今晚派對的這位同事！

questions.en: What was the company like twenty years ago?
questions.zh: 二十年前公司是什麼樣子？

questions.en: Why does he say the company succeeded?
questions.zh: 他說公司成功的原因是什麼？

options: One of the first two people
Someone who joined a year ago

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Come on up here, please. This award is for you.
scene.zh: 請上台來。這個獎是你的。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I really wasn't expecting this, but thank you so much!
scene.zh: 我真的完全沒想到，非常謝謝大家！

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Your first year has been truly impressive.
scene.zh: 你這第一年的表現真的很出色。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: You worked hard on every job we gave you.
scene.zh: 交給你的每件工作你都很認真。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: And tonight's party is a big success, too!
scene.zh: 而且今晚的派對也辦得很成功！

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Now, let's get a picture of you with the award.
scene.zh: 來，我們幫你和獎盃拍張照。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Congratulations! You really deserve this award.
scene.zh: 恭喜！這個獎你當之無愧。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: You look a little embarrassed. Don't be!
scene.zh: 你看起來有點不好意思。不用這樣啦！

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Thank you for encouraging me all year.
scene.zh: 謝謝您這一整年一直鼓勵我。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: My pleasure. I really admire how hard you work.
scene.zh: 不客氣。我真的很佩服你這麼努力。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: You achieved a lot this year. You should be proud of that.
scene.zh: 你今年做到了很多事，應該為自己感到驕傲。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Next year, I'd like to give you a bigger role.
scene.zh: 明年我想讓你負責更重要的工作。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I'd love to take on more responsibility next year.
scene.zh: 明年我很樂意多負責一些事情。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Good. Let's talk on Monday. Now go enjoy your night!
scene.zh: 很好。我們星期一再談。現在去好好享受今晚吧！

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Here we are. So this is Lakeside Hall.
scene.zh: 到了。這就是 Lakeside Hall。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: They have two Saturdays free this month.
scene.zh: 他們這個月有兩個星期六有空。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Do you have a date in mind for the party?
scene.zh: 派對的日期您有想法了嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: The later one, I think. That gives us more time.
scene.zh: 我想選後面那個，這樣我們時間比較充裕。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Mr. Ellis will want to say a few words, of course.
scene.zh: Ellis 先生當然會想上台講幾句話。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Does the hall have a stage for the speeches?
scene.zh: 那個宴會廳有可以致詞的舞台嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Yes, a small one, over there by the windows.
scene.zh: 有，一個小舞台，在窗戶那邊。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Let me make sure the microphone is working.
scene.zh: 我確認一下麥克風有沒有聲音。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: It works. I can hear you fine from back here!
scene.zh: 可以用。我在後面這裡聽得很清楚！

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Good. Did they give you the menu, Dan?
scene.zh: 很好。Dan，他們有給你菜單嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Yes. It's a buffet, and everything is fresh.
scene.zh: 有。是自助式的，東西都很新鮮。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Are there any dishes for guests who don't eat meat?
scene.zh: 有沒有不吃肉的來賓也能吃的菜？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Yes, four vegetarian dishes. They look good, too.
scene.zh: 有，四道素食的菜，看起來也不錯。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: But what if eighty people are really hungry?
scene.zh: 可是如果八十個人都很餓怎麼辦？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: If we run out of food, I'll let the caterer know.
scene.zh: 如果菜不夠了，我會跟外燴業者說。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Perfect. So, what's next?
scene.zh: 太好了。那接下來呢？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I'll send out the invitations before I leave today.
scene.zh: 我今天下班前會把邀請函寄出去。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Great. And Mr. Ellis wants you at his table that night. He has an award for you.
scene.zh: 很好。還有，Ellis 先生那天晚上想請你坐他那桌，他有個獎要頒給你。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I really wasn't expecting this, but thank you so much!
scene.zh: 我真的完全沒想到，非常謝謝！

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: You've done great work this year. You deserve it.
scene.zh: 你今年表現得很好，這是你應得的。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Thank you for encouraging me all year.
scene.zh: 謝謝您這一整年一直鼓勵我。
